rv.q: Compelling drama from Laurie Motherwell of a friendship forged in pigeon-fancying
Motherwell's script is funny and unpredictable with complex and likeable characters.
Laurie Motherwell’s new lunchtime play Roost offers a slow and bumpy journey towards its powerful ending.

cn.t: Mixed reviews for this Scottish social drama about a father facing assessment after leaving his daughter alone. Critics find the pigeon-keeping premise intriguing but execution uneven.
